Because PPV is prevalence-dependent, F1 can vary substantially across populations with different prevalence and case-mix, limiting transportability.

The rule of thumb for VRAM calculation follows the formula: `M = (P × Q/8) × 1.2`, where M represents required memory in GB, P is the parameter count in billions, Q is precision in bits, and 1.2 accounts for overhead.
